definitions.explanation: A map showing only outlines such as borders and coastlines, with place names and other details left blank. Used in geography classes for students to fill in.

examples.japanese: {白地図|はくちず}に{県名|けんめい}を{書|か}き{込|こ}む。
examples.english: I fill in the prefecture names on a blank map.

examples.japanese: {宿題|しゅくだい}で{日本|にほん}の{白地図|はくちず}に{川|かわ}の{名前|なまえ}を{記入|きにゅう}した。
examples.english: For homework, I wrote the river names onto a blank map of Japan.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}は{白地図|はくちず}を{配|くば}り、{世界|せかい}の{国|くに}の{位置|いち}を{覚|おぼ}えさせた。
examples.english: The teacher handed out blank maps and had us memorize the locations of the world's countries.

notes:
Composed of {白|はく} (blank, white) + {地図|ちず} (map). A standard tool in geography education.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白地図|はくちず}に{書|か}き{込|こ}む: to fill in a blank map
- {白地図|はくちず}を{配|くば}る: to hand out blank maps

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {地図|ちず}: map — the general word; a {白地図|はくちず} is a map with the labels removed
